This petition has been filed challenging the Public Notice dated 31st July, 2025 issued under Section 21 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 ('Act of 2013'), in respect to the land described in the prayer clause.

Issue a Writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ, direction or order directing respondents to handover the peaceful possession of the land comprised in Khasra No. 76/27 admeasuring 6 bighas 4 biswas situated in the Revenue Estate of Village Mehrauli, NCT of Delhi to the Petitioners."
2. It is stated that this acquisition forms part of Review Petition (C) No.400/2023, which was included in the batch of petitions which were disposed of by the Supreme Court in Govt. of NCT of Delhi vs. K.L Rathi Steels Limited and Ors. 2024 7 SCC 315, where directions were passed inter alia in paragraph 128 of the said judgement.

6. Notices are also accepted by Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, Standing Counsel appears for respondent nos.1 & 2 and Ms. Malvika Kapila, Counsel who appears for Delhi Development Authority (DDA).

7. Issue notice to the remaining respondent, returnable on 22nd September, 2025.
